name: 6N137
description: High-speed 10 MBd optocoupler, logic output with enable
source: https://www.vishay.com/docs/84732/6n137.pdf — Vishay doc. 84732 rev. 2.2, single-channel pinout figure, page 1
notes: A = LED anode, C = LED cathode, VE = enable, VO = open-drain output (needs a pull-up). 0.1 µF between pins 5 and 8 recommended. Only the Vishay datasheet was checked; dual-channel relatives (VO2630 …) differ.
